verdict.rationale: three.js provides an official SDK (the library itself) with extensive docs, an llms.txt file for AI consumption, and TSL/WebGPU node APIs, but this is not an 'official SDK' in the sense of AI-agent-oriented tooling like an OpenAPI spec or agent-ready API surface — there's no OpenAPI/machine-readable API contract (404s on probes) and no evidence of official SDKs for other languages beyond the core JS/TS library. missing for 10: OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, evidence of multi-language official SDKs, and independent confirmation of AI-native tooling beyond llms.txt.
